description_en: Registers an agent - Step 2: Generates a DNS record for domain ownership verification
description_zh: 注册Agent - 步骤二：生成域名归属验证解析记录
name: CreateAtiAgentRegisterInfoAcmeChallengeRecord

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken value. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. The ID is automatically generated during the agent registration process. When registering or querying through APIs, this ID must be carried throughout the entire process. Call the ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos operation to query the target agent and obtain the AgentRegisterInfoId from the response
parameters.help_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册、查询流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，需调用接口 ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos 查询目标Agent后从应答内容获取AgentRegisterInfoId
parameters.name: agent_register_info_id

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. The ID is automatically generated during the agent registration process. In the multi-step registration process through APIs, this ID must be carried throughout all steps to ensure that each step is associated with the same agent and the complete registration process is fulfilled
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环
